title: Index Funds Reached 52%—And Their Managers Cast The Votes
hook: Index funds reached 52% of the measured assets; managers wield the voting power.
closing: Fund ownership also concentrates voting responsibilities, so look beyond fees when deciding who manages investments.
question: Who should decide how fund shares vote?

segments.say: Index funds reached 52% of assets in the supplied series. Passive investing had become the majority of the measured pool.
BlackRock, Vanguard and State Street hold a combined 22% stake in the average large company here. Concentrated management has consequences.
Vanguard casts 9% of the annual-meeting votes in this comparison. Owning through a fund is different from casting those votes personally.
